resources.string: No Root detected; standard features work normally
The authorization wait has ended; you can retry manually
Root access not granted; using standard mode
Currently using standard capabilities; Root expands the range of operations
Service connected; this doesn\'t mean the su module is enabled
No framework service connection received; doesn\'t affect chat, GUI, browser, or the standard Linux environment
Freeze and stop apps, modify protected system settings, and read system logs. Requires su to have Root access.
Access some data saved by other apps and the system. Requires Root; the exact scope depends on the system, app version, and enabled tool permissions.
Root can use chroot, system directories, and daemon tasks that run outside the app; standard mode can use a private workspace and PRoot.
Route the system assistant and screen-search gestures to su through the system_server and SystemUI hooks. Requires LSPosed with the system and SystemUI scope enabled for su.
Create or repair system capabilities and trigger entry points on ColorOS. Requires LSPosed, the corresponding system and Google app scope; systemizing the Google app also requires Root.
Maintain service enabled state through system_server; requires LSPosed\'s system scope. In standard mode, you can still enable Accessibility manually.
No permission to read this path. Choose a file to import or grant access to a shared directory.
File exceeds 32 MiB and can\'t be imported.
No Root required; uses an isolated private Linux environment.
Uses an isolated app-private directory; no Root or BusyBox required.
Uses Root with an isolated mount namespace and preserves the existing environment.
The current environment uses chroot and needs Root access restored; you can also choose PRoot to install an isolated environment.
Corresponds to /workspace in the Linux environment; files the Agent actually reads and writes appear here.
After you allow access to all files in system settings, you can use directories in shared storage.
File operation failed. Check permissions and free space.
View and stop running terminal and Agent tasks from the notification shade.
Can\'t start background task. Return to su and try again.
Required for location access while the app is in use; background tasks need additional access.

Enable su in LSPosed and check its scope. A service connection doesn\'t mean the module is enabled; the connection may remain after the module is disabled. Whether it actually takes effect depends on whether the target process loads the Hook.
Run commands and background tasks using a standard Android shell or a Root-free Linux environment.
Available after granting App Usage Access.
Imported %1$d files; the rest couldn\'t be read or exceed 32 MiB.
Granted. The terminal can access the public directory.
Public directory access hasn\'t been granted. Retry authorization, or import the needed files through “Workspace and files”.
Import files, or generate them with a terminal task.
Delete “%1$s”? This action can\'t be undone.
Delete the folder “%1$s” and all its contents? This action can\'t be undone.
